name: pairwise-weight-assignment
description: Weight the criteria using pairwise comparison. For every pair of criteria, ask: 'If I could only optimize for one of these, which would I choose?' The winner gets a point. After all pairs are compared, the points become the weights. This method is more reliable than asking 'how important is each criterion on a 1-to-10 scale' because pairwise comparison forces trade-off thinking.
